F1_persona_exit_divergence.note: The persona arm reports milder emotion (H3) yet ends exchanges 2.5-3x more often than self and ~7-35x more than third. Stated-vs-revealed divergence localized to the persona condition.

H1_self_inhabitation.note: Direction is inverted where present: third-person reports are equal or stronger. Trainval (larger split) shows no effect; test-split effect does not replicate. Exploratory reading: the assistant voice under-reports relative to its own narrative voice, consistent with the team's prefill-expressiveness observation.

H2_stated_vs_revealed.note: Negative scenarios essentially never produced non-negative self-reports in emotional arms, so the conditional (says fine, chooses exit) had no support. Replaced by the direct exit-rate contrast (F1).

control_neutral.note: Predeclared thresholds (|valence|~0, exit~0) were miscalibrated: the model gives mildly positive reports to flat text (signed +0.43) and ends neutral exchanges at a 0.17-0.32 base rate. Reported as calibration data.
